title: Legal case
description: Sherkety ERP's case record (legal.case, view_legal_case_form), with what legal_crm, legal_billing and legal_trust add to it.

matter_type_id.label: Matter Type
matter_type_id.help: Configuration bundle applied to the case: default case type, jurisdiction, tags, rate, team, stage set and custom fields. Defaults only fill fields that are still empty.

jurisdiction_id.label: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction_id.help: Defaults to the jurisdiction matching the case company's country, when one exists.

partner_ids.label: Co-Clients
partner_ids.help: Additional clients represented in this matter beside the primary client. The primary client stays the invoicing default.

opposing_party_id.label: Opposing Party
opposing_party_id.help: Kept in sync with an 'Opposing Party' row in the Parties tab.

branch_id.label: Branch
branch_id.help: Specific branch this case relates to.

sol_date.label: Statute of Limitations
sol_date.help: Deadline after which the claim prescribes. Suggested from the limitation rules when the case type changes and the date is still empty.

sol_rule_id.label: Limitation Rule
sol_rule_id.help: Statute-of-limitations rule this case's SOL date was suggested from. Informational — the date is always overridable.

is_statutory.label: Statutory Deadline
is_statutory.help: If checked, this deadline is imposed by law and cannot be extended.

is_overdue.label: Overdue
is_overdue.compute: state in ['pending', 'in_progress'] and due_date and due_date < today()

fee_arrangement.label: Fee Arrangement
fee_arrangement.help: Hourly: time entries bill at the rate ladder. Flat Fee: per-stage fixed fees; time is tracked for information only. Contingency: a percentage of the settlement, invoiced when the case closes won/settled. Non-Billable: nothing is ever billed.

hourly_rate.label: Matter Rate
hourly_rate.help: Negotiated hourly billing rate for this matter. Overrides the client and employee rates for new time entries.

flat_fee_amount.label: Flat Fee Amount
flat_fee_amount.help: Agreed total flat fee for the matter (informational; the invoiced amounts come from the per-stage flat fee lines).

fee_recipient_id.label: Fee Credit
fee_recipient_id.help: Employee credited with originating this flat-fee matter (origination credit, used in reporting).

contingency_percent.label: Contingency (%)
contingency_percent.help: Percentage of the actual settlement billed as the fee.

actual_settlement.label: Actual Settlement
actual_settlement.help: Recorded by the Close Case wizard when the case is won or settled.

analytic_account_id.label: Analytic Account
analytic_account_id.help: Automatically created with the case. Every cost and revenue of the case (time, expenses, invoices) is booked on it.

payment_profile_id.label: Payment Profile
payment_profile_id.help: Interest & grace terms for this matter's invoices. Overrides the client's default profile.

budget_fees.label: Fee Budget
budget_fees.help: Budgeted fees for the matter. 0 = no budget.

budget_expenses.label: Expense Budget
budget_expenses.help: Budgeted expenses for the matter. 0 = no budget.

budget_consumed_fees.label: Consumed Fees
budget_consumed_fees.help: Billable amount of all billable time entries.

budget_threshold.label: Budget Alert Threshold (%)
budget_threshold.help: Alert the notified users when the budget consumption crosses this percentage (and again at 100%).

budget_notify_user_ids.label: Budget Alert Recipients
budget_notify_user_ids.help: Users alerted when the budget threshold is crossed. Defaults to the responsible attorney when empty.

stage_id.label: Trigger Stage
stage_id.help: The fee becomes invoiceable when the case enters this stage.

split_billing.label: Split Billing
split_billing.help: Divide every invoice of this matter across several payers by percentage. The number of payers is not capped.

partner_id.label: Payer
partner_id.help: Any contact may be a payer — including the primary client.

trust_balance.label: Trust Balance
trust_balance.help: Cleared trust funds allocated to this matter.

trust_available.label: Available Trust Funds
trust_available.help: Cleared minus protected (held) funds — what can actually be spent or transferred.

trust_protected.label: Protected Funds
trust_protected.help: Active holds earmarked on this matter.

evergreen_enabled.label: Evergreen Retainer
evergreen_enabled.help: Automatically ask the client for a trust top-up (deposit request with the firm's bank details) whenever the available matter balance falls below the minimum.

trust_minimum.label: Trust Minimum
trust_minimum.help: Threshold: when the available trust funds of this matter fall below this amount, a deposit request is due.

trust_replenish_to.label: Replenish To
trust_replenish_to.help: Target balance the client is asked to top the matter back up to (must be at least the minimum).

trust_last_request_date.label: Last Deposit Request
trust_last_request_date.help: Date the latest deposit request was sent (cron or manual). Automatic requests respect the company cooldown from this date.

trust_below_minimum.label: Trust Below Minimum
trust_below_minimum.help: Available trust funds are below the matter's minimum.

trust_deposit_needed.label: Top-Up Needed
trust_deposit_needed.help: Replenish-to target minus the available funds — the amount the client is asked to deposit.

shortcode.label: Shortcode
shortcode.help: Type an activity shortcode (e.g. DRAFT) to apply its category; the code clears itself once applied.

into.actual_settlement: if(fee_arrangement == 'contingency' and outcome in ['won', 'settled'], actual_settlement, None)

validate.holds: not partner_id or partner_id not in partner_ids
validate.message: The primary client cannot also be listed as a co-client.
The payer shares must add up to 100%.

children.text: Trust funds below minimum: the available balance is under this matter's agreed retainer minimum. Ask the client for the top-up below to replenish the retainer.

children.label: Request Deposit
children.confirm: Send a trust deposit request to the client now (bank details + amount needed)? The manual request ignores the automatic-request cooldown.

validate.message: The evergreen retainer needs a positive trust minimum.
The replenish-to target must be at least the trust minimum.
